title: Read cache entry
description: One action-cache entry (ADR-0008): the action key, the full key material, output blob digests, and the recorded result. Written last, after every blob exists; verified on every read.

cache_format.description: Layout and key-derivation version; a change invalidates every entry.

key.description: SHA-256 of the domain tag plus canonical JSON of 'action'.

action.description: Everything that can change the result. Recomputed into 'key' on every read.

name.description: Logical output name; never a path.

result.description: What the action reported (converter, confidence cap, attempts, warnings). Replayed on a hit.
